title: Wide byte-pass diagram is unreadable in the PDF
lead: Make the widened byte-pass diagram in docs/how-it-works.md legible in the PDF render (the text is 3 to 4 pt) by changing its layout or splitting it. **Not in this slice:** changing any other diagram, the content of the diagram, or the renderer.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: sq-46 widened the byte-pass diagram (invalid-byte locations); the gate noted its text is very small in the PDF. A 1.0.0 docs page is a release artifact (goal: explained in plain language, with a PDF render).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `docs/how-it-works.md` (the byte-pass diagram in the pipeline section), `docs/how-it-works.html`, `docs/how-it-works.pdf` (regenerated), CONTRIBUTING.md diagram rules if a rule is added.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - If a docs test checks diagram labels or sizes, it covers the changed diagram; otherwise the check is the render: no diagram text in the PDF is smaller than the implementer states as the floor (measure it from the rendered PDF and report the figure).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Re-anchor the diagram, measure the current smallest text in the PDF. 2. Change the layout (top-down, or split in two) without changing meaning. 3. Re-render with `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" ./scripts/render-docs.sh` and commit .md, .html and .pdf together (the owner commits).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Docs tests pass; build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
